rule.en:
To say who has something, add **'s** to the owner: **Jack's dog**, **Granny Maggie's kitchen**, **the teacher's bag**. The owner comes first, then the thing.

A plural in -s takes only the apostrophe: **the girls' bikes** (more than one girl), **the Dixons' house**. Irregular plurals take 's: **the children's books**, **the men's boots**. For things, **of** is more usual: **the top of the fell**, **the end of the road**.

The possessive words are **my**, **your**, **his** (a boy's or man's), **her** (a girl's or woman's), **its** (a thing's or an animal's), **our**, **their**. They follow the owner only, never the thing, and never change: **his sister**, **her brother**, **their dogs**. They take the place of the article: **my dog**, not *the my dog*.

With no noun after them, use **mine**, **yours**, **his**, **hers**, **ours**, **theirs**: **Is this yours? — Yes, it's mine.** Careful: **its** has no apostrophe; **it's** means it is.
rule.sl:
Ko povemo, čigavo je kaj, lastniku dodamo **'s**: **Jack's dog** (Jackov pes), **Granny Maggie's kitchen** (kuhinja babice Maggie), **the teacher's bag** (učiteljičina torba). Kot pri slovenskem -ov, -in: najprej lastnik, nato stvar.

Množina na -s dobi samo opuščaj: **the girls' bikes** (kolesa deklet), **the Dixons' house**. Nepravilne množine dobijo 's: **the children's books**, **the men's boots**. Za stvari je pogostejši **of**: **the top of the fell** (vrh hriba), **the end of the road**.

Svojilne besede so **my**, **your**, **his** (njegov), **her** (njen), **its** (od stvari ali živali), **our**, **their**. Ravnajo se le po lastniku, nikoli po stvari, in se ne spreminjajo: **his sister** (njegova sestra), **her brother** (njen brat). Angleščina nima besede svoj: **I love my dog, Jack loves his dog.** Stojijo namesto člena: **my dog**, ne *the my dog*.

Brez samostalnika za njimi: **mine**, **yours**, **his**, **hers**, **ours**, **theirs**: **Is this yours? — Yes, it's mine.** (Je to tvoje? — Ja, moje je.) Pazi: **its** nima opuščaja, **it's** pomeni it is.
rule.it:
Per dire di chi è una cosa, al possessore si aggiunge **'s**: **Jack's dog** (il cane di Jack), **Granny Maggie's kitchen** (la cucina di nonna Maggie), **the teacher's bag**. L'ordine è rovesciato: prima il possessore, poi la cosa.

Un plurale in -s prende solo l'apostrofo: **the girls' bikes** (le bici delle ragazze), **the Dixons' house**. I plurali irregolari prendono 's: **the children's books**, **the men's boots**. Per le cose si usa più spesso **of**: **the top of the fell** (la cima del monte), **the end of the road**.

I possessivi sono **my**, **your**, **his** (di lui), **her** (di lei), **its** (di una cosa o di un animale), **our**, **their**. Dipendono solo dal possessore, mai dalla cosa, e non cambiano: il suo cane è **his dog** se è di Jack, **her dog** se è di Poppy. Non prendono l'articolo: **my dog** (il mio cane), non *the my dog*.

Senza nome dopo: **mine**, **yours**, **his**, **hers**, **ours**, **theirs**: **Is this yours? — Yes, it's mine.** (È tuo? — Sì, è mio.) Attenzione: **its** non ha l'apostrofo, **it's** vuol dire it is.
rule.de:
Um zu sagen, wem etwas gehört, bekommt der Besitzer **'s**: **Jack's dog** (Jacks Hund), **Granny Maggie's kitchen** (Oma Maggies Küche), **the teacher's bag**. Wie im Deutschen, aber mit Apostroph.

Ein Plural auf -s bekommt nur den Apostroph: **the girls' bikes** (die Fahrräder der Mädchen), **the Dixons' house**. Unregelmäßige Plurale bekommen 's: **the children's books**, **the men's boots**. Bei Dingen ist **of** üblicher: **the top of the fell** (der Gipfel des Berges), **the end of the road**.

Die Possessivwörter sind **my**, **your**, **his** (sein), **her** (ihr), **its** (sein oder ihr, bei Dingen und Tieren), **our**, **their**. Wie sein und ihr richten sie sich nach dem Besitzer, aber sie ändern sich nie: **his dog**, **his sister**, **with his dogs** (sein Hund, seine Schwester, mit seinen Hunden). Sie ersetzen den Artikel: **my dog**, nicht *the my dog*.

Ohne Nomen danach: **mine**, **yours**, **his**, **hers**, **ours**, **theirs**: **Is this yours? — Yes, it's mine.** (Ist das deins? — Ja, das ist meins.) Achtung: **its** hat keinen Apostroph, **it's** heißt it is.

examples.en: This is Jack's dog. Her name is Meg.
examples.sl: To je Jackova psička. Ime ji je Meg.
examples.it: Questa è la cagnolina di Jack. Si chiama Meg.
examples.de: Das ist Jacks Hündin. Sie heißt Meg.

note.en: Meg is a girl dog, so her name.
note.sl: Meg je psička, zato her name.
note.it: Meg è femmina, quindi her name.
note.de: Meg ist eine Hündin, also her name.

examples.en: Granny Maggie's kitchen smells of scones.
examples.sl: Kuhinja babice Maggie diši po pogačicah.
examples.it: La cucina di nonna Maggie profuma di scones.
examples.de: Oma Maggies Küche riecht nach Scones.

examples.en: The girls' bikes are behind the barn.
examples.it: Le bici delle ragazze sono dietro il fienile.
examples.de: Die Fahrräder der Mädchen stehen hinter der Scheune.

note.en: More than one girl: girls' (the apostrophe after the s).
note.it: Più ragazze: girls' (l'apostrofo dopo la s).
note.de: Mehrere Mädchen: girls' (Apostroph nach dem s).

examples.en: Poppy is feeding her rabbit, and Alfie is feeding his.
examples.sl: Poppy hrani svojega zajčka, Alfie pa svojega.
examples.it: Poppy dà da mangiare al suo coniglio, e Alfie al suo.
examples.de: Poppy füttert ihr Kaninchen, und Alfie füttert seins.

note.en: The owner decides: her for Poppy, his for Alfie.
note.sl: Odloča lastnik: her za Poppy, his za Alfieja (slovensko obakrat svoj).
note.it: Decide il possessore: her per Poppy, his per Alfie (in italiano tutti e due suo).
note.de: Der Besitzer entscheidet: her für Poppy, his für Alfie.

examples.en: Is this yours, Harry? — No, it's Alfie's.
examples.sl: Je to tvoje, Harry? — Ne, Alfiejevo je.
examples.it: È tuo, Harry? — No, è di Alfie.
examples.de: Ist das deins, Harry? — Nein, das ist Alfies.

examples.en: The top of the fell is in the clouds.
examples.it: La cima del monte è tra le nuvole.
examples.de: Der Gipfel des Berges liegt in den Wolken.

note.en: For things: of (not the fell's top).
note.sl: Pri stvareh: of (ne the fell's top).
note.it: Per le cose: of (non the fell's top).
note.de: Bei Dingen: of (nicht the fell's top).

examples.en: Our house is next to the inn. Where's yours?
examples.sl: Naša hiša je zraven gostilne. Kje je tvoja?
examples.it: La nostra casa è accanto alla locanda. Dov'è la tua?
examples.de: Unser Haus ist neben dem Gasthaus. Wo ist deins?
